description: This file defines the ComponentContainer class, which is responsible for loading and initializing component configurations in the OFBiz framework. It manages dependencies, loads components from directories, handles load files, and ensures components are loaded before other containers execute.

classes.name: ComponentContainer
classes.description: Implements the Container interface to load and initialize components in OFBiz. Manages component dependencies, directories, and load files to ensure correct startup order and resource loading.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with OFBiz startup commands, container name, and configuration file argument.

methods.name: init (overloaded)
methods.description: Loads components from a specified directory, preventing multiple loads and handling root components based on configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns whether the components have been successfully loaded and started.

methods.name: loadComponent
methods.description: Loads a specific component or directory based on its type (directory or single component).

methods.name: loadComponentDirectory
methods.description: Loads all components within a directory, checking for a load file or loading all subdirectories.

methods.name: loadComponentsInDirectoryUsingLoadFile
methods.description: Loads components listed in a load XML file within a directory.

methods.name: loadComponentsInDirectory
methods.description: Loads components in a directory without a load file, sorting them alphabetically.

methods.name: retrieveComponentConfig
methods.description: Loads a component configuration from its directory location.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping container operations (empty implementation).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.
